children: August U.S. housing starts: -2.6% M/M to a seasonally adjusted annual rate of 1.275M vs. 1.315M consensus and 1.309M prior (revised from 1.239M), according to data released by the U.S. Census Bureau on Friday.
Building permits: -2.7% M/M to a seasonally adjusted annual rate of 1.394M vs. 1.400M consensus and 1.443M prior.
